status: complete; opt-in integration correct, cold exact-key capture not beneficial in tested cells

decision.followup: Approval required: longer-horizon exact-key reuse, then an independent padded/bucketed-graph safety design if warranted

metric_contract.throughput: committed tokens / serving wall time, never sum(request E2E)
metric_contract.percentiles: pooled requests for TTFT/E2E/TPOT; pooled committed-token intervals for ITL
metric_contract.cache_hit_rate: replays / all verification batches; eligible_hit_rate has eligible denominator
metric_contract.key_counts: per-trial unique keys summed across trials, not global de-duplicated identities
metric_contract.capture_amortization: same-key noncapture eager versus replay endpoint means; observational estimate
metric_contract.memory: allocated deltas include first-use engine workspace; reserved deltas are allocator proxies, not ownership
metric_contract.partition: disjoint rank-0 host wall endpoints; not isolated GPU kernel time; draft catch-up is nested
metric_contract.graph_cold_start: cache, occurrence history and capture allowance reset each measured trial
metric_contract.eager_baseline: same-process opt-in runner with GraphCache disabled; frozen eager arithmetic and transactions
metric_contract.target_forwards: legacy Phase4.2 target_forwards excludes speculative prefill; explicit serving/executed counts add prefill and three capture warmups. Capture recordings are separate, not additional executed GPU forwards.
metric_contract.rank1_peak: rank0 peak is trial-local; the frozen collector resets only rank0 allocator counters. Rank1 peak snapshots can include earlier trials; report process maxima and instantaneous/release values, not purported isolated per-trial rank1 peaks.
